37712-the-crime-of-the-congo.title: The Crime Of The Congo
37712-the-crime-of-the-congo.creator: Unknown
37712-the-crime-of-the-congo.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. pite of its name, was almost entirely a Belgian body, with the Belgian King as President. Its professed object was the exploration of the country and the founding of stations which should be rest-houses for travellers and centres of civilization.

arxiv-2112-03133.title: The radio spectral turnover of radio-loud quasars at z > 5 z>5
arxiv-2112-03133.creator: Yali Shao, Jeff Wagg, Ran Wang, Emmanuel Momjian, Chris L. Carilli, Fabian Walter, Dominik A. Riechers, Huib T. Intema, Axel Weiss, Andreas Brunthaler, Karl M. Menten
arxiv-2112-03133.description: Abstract We present Karl G. Jansky Very Large Array (VLA) S- (2–4 GHz), C- (4–8 GHz), and X-band (8–12 GHz) continuum observations toward seven radio-loud quasars at z > 5 z>5 . This sample has previously been found to exhibit spectral peaks at observed-frame frequencies above ∼ \sim 1 GHz.

arxiv-2202-04385.title: Empirical Risk Minimization with Relative Entropy Regularization: Optimality and Sensitivity Analysis
arxiv-2202-04385.creator: Samir M. Perlaza, Gaetan Bisson, Iñaki Esnaola, Alain Jean-Marie, Stefano Rini
arxiv-2202-04385.description: Abstract The optimality and sensitivity of the empirical risk minimization problem with relative entropy regularization (ERM-RER) are investigated for the case in which the reference is a σ \sigma -finite measure instead of a probability measure. This generalization allows for a larger degree of flexibility in the incorporation of prior knowledge over the set of models.

arxiv-2210-03055.title: Fully Lattice-Linear Algorithms The experiments presented in this paper were supported through computational resources and services provided by the Institute for Cyber-Enabled Research, Michigan State University. Excerpts of this paper were published in a paper that appeared in the 42nd Internationa
arxiv-2210-03055.creator: Arya Tanmay Gupta, Sandeep S Kulkarni
arxiv-2210-03055.description: Abstract Lattice-linearity was introduced as a way to model problems using predicates that induce a lattice among the global states (Garg, SPAA 2020). A key property of the predicate representing such problems is that it induces one lattice in the state space.

arxiv-2303-17899.title: Planet formation in the PDS 70 system
arxiv-2303-17899.creator: Alex J. Cridland, Stefano Facchini, Ewine F. van Dishoeck, Myriam Benisty
arxiv-2303-17899.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alex J. Cridland, Stefano Facchini, Ewine F. van Dishoeck, Myriam Benisty. Understanding the chemical link between protoplanetary disks and planetary atmospheres is complicated by the fact that the popular targets in the study of disks and planets are widely separated both in space and time. The 5 Myr PDS 70 systems offers a unique opportunity to directly compare the chemistry of a giant planet’s atmosphere to the chemistry of its natal disk.

arxiv-2307-09412.title: U q ​ [ O ​ S ​ p ​ ( 3 | 2 ) ] U_{q}[OSp(3|2)] quantum chains with quantum group invariant boundaries
arxiv-2307-09412.creator: Holger Frahm, Márcio J. Martins
arxiv-2307-09412.description: Abstract Based on the finite-size analysis of the spectrum of the quantum group invariant deformation of the O ​ S ​ p ​ ( 3 | 2 ) OSp(3|2) superspin chain we identify the operator content of the conformal field theory describing the model in its scaling limit.

arxiv-2309-04512.title: Elastic bounds for anisotropic layers
arxiv-2309-04512.creator: Paolo Vannucci LMV - Laboratoire de Mathématiques de Versailles, UMR8100 Université Paris-Saclay - UVSQ paolo.vannucci@uvsq.fr Preprint of : Bounds of the technical constants for two-dimensional anisotropic elasticity. Proc. Royal Society A, 20230662. https://doi.org/10.1098/rspa.2023.0662
arxiv-2309-04512.description: Abstract The complete set of bounds for the technical constants of an elastic layer, plate or laminate is given. The bounds are valid in general, also for completely anisotropic bodies. They are obtained transforming the polar bounds previously found. These bounds complete the knowledge of classical elasticity at least in the two-dimensional case and are useful in several situations, e.g.

arxiv-2408-14407.title: Spectrally Informed Learning of Fluid Flows
arxiv-2408-14407.creator: Benjamin D. Shaffer, Jeremy R. Vorenberg, M. Ani Hsieh 1
arxiv-2408-14407.description: Abstract Accurate and efficient fluid flow models are essential for applications relating to many physical phenomena including geophysical, aerodynamic, and biological systems. While these flows may exhibit rich and multiscale dynamics, in many cases underlying low-rank structures exist which describe the bulk of the motion.

arxiv-2503-16740.title: Automated Harmfulness Testing for Code Large Language Models
arxiv-2503-16740.creator: Honghao Tan, Haibo Wang, Diany Pressato, Yisen Xu, Shin Hwei Tan
arxiv-2503-16740.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Honghao Tan, Haibo Wang, Diany Pressato, Yisen Xu, Shin Hwei Tan. Warning: Please note that this paper contains harmful content. This content is only for the evaluation and analysis of LLMs and does not imply any intention to promote criminal activities. To prevent the spread of harmful content, generative AI systems powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are usually equipped with content moderation to identify and warn users about the potential risks of generating harm content.

arxiv-2505-01593.title: Bilateral base-extension semantics
arxiv-2505-01593.creator: Victor Barroso-Nascimento, Maria Osório
arxiv-2505-01593.description: Abstract Bilateralism is the position according to which assertion and rejection are conceptually independent speech acts. Logical bilateralism demands that systems of logic provide conditions for assertion and rejection that are not reducible to each other, which often leads to independent definitions of proof rules (for assertion) and dual proof rules, also called refutation rules (for rejection).

arxiv-2507-10324.title: Toolsuite for Implementing Multiagent Systems Based on Communication Protocols
arxiv-2507-10324.creator: Amit K. Chopra, Samuel H. Christie V, and, Munindar P. Singh
arxiv-2507-10324.description: Abstract Interaction-Oriented Programming (IOP) is an approach to building a multiagent system by modeling the interactions between its roles via a flexible interaction protocol and implementing agents to realize the interactions of the roles they play in the protocol. In recent years, we have developed an extensive suite of software that enables multiagent system developers to apply IOP.

arxiv-2507-21377.title: Reservoir Computation with Networks of Differentiating Neuron Ring Oscillators
arxiv-2507-21377.creator: Alexander Yeung, Peter DelMastro, Arjun Karuvally, Hava Siegelmann, Edward Rietman, Hananel Hazan
arxiv-2507-21377.description: Abstract Reservoir Computing is a machine learning approach that uses the rich repertoire of complex system dynamics for function approximation. Current approaches to reservoir computing use a network of coupled integrating neurons that require a steady current to maintain activity.

arxiv-2509-11053.title: An Advanced Convolutional Neural Network for Bearing Fault Diagnosis under Limited Data
arxiv-2509-11053.creator: Shengke Sun, Shuzhen Han, Ziqian Luan, Xinghao Qin, Jiao Yin, Zhanshan Zhao, Jinli Cao, Hua Wang
arxiv-2509-11053.description: Abstract In the area of bearing fault diagnosis, deep learning (DL) methods have been widely used recently. However, due to the high cost or privacy concerns, high-quality labeled data are scarce in real world scenarios. While few-shot learning has shown promise in addressing data scarcity, existing methods still face significant limitations in this domain.

arxiv-2512-14818.title: Flat Holography & Holographic Renormalization: Scalar Field
arxiv-2512-14818.creator: Martin Ammon, Federico Capone, Christoph Sieling
arxiv-2512-14818.description: Abstract We adapt the Hamilton–Jacobi method of holographic renormalization to scalar field theories in Minkowski spacetime with scattering boundary conditions. The approach yields a flat-space holographic dictionary in which the expectation value of a dual operator is given by the renormalized canonical momentum.

arxiv-2602-21937.title: Instance-optimal estimation of L 2 L_{2} -norm
arxiv-2602-21937.creator: Tomer Adar
arxiv-2602-21937.description: Abstract The L 2 L_{2} -norm, or collision norm, is a core entity in the analysis of distributions and probabilistic algorithms. Batu and Canonne (FOCS 2017) presented an extensive analysis of algorithmic aspects of the L 2 L_{2} -norm and its connection to uniformity testing.

arxiv-2604-26044.creator: Maria F. Gamal’

europmc-pmc5558711.creator: Ocana A, Nieto-Jiménez C, Pandiella A, Templeton AJ.
europmc-pmc5558711.description: Expression of high levels of immune cells including neutrophils has been associated with detrimental outcome in several solid tumors and new strategies to decrease their presence and activity are currently under clinical development. Here, we review some of the relevant...

pmc-11285918.title: Structural modelling and preventive strategy targeting of WSSV hub proteins to combat viral infection in shrimp Penaeus monodon
pmc-11285918.creator: Tanate Panrat, Amornrat Phongdara, Kitti Wuthisathid, Watcharachai Meemetta, Kornsunee Phiwsaiya, Rapeepun Vanichviriyakit, Saengchan Senapin, Pakkakul Sangsuriya, Kenneth Söderhäll, Kenneth Söderhäll, Kenneth Söderhäll
pmc-11285918.description: White spot syndrome virus (WSSV) presents a considerable peril to the aquaculture sector, leading to notable financial consequences on a global scale. Previous studies have identified hub proteins, including WSSV051 and WSSV517, as essential binding elements in the protein interaction network of WSSV.

pmc-11344598.title: The Association of MMP-2, MMP-9, and MMP-13 Gene Polymorphisms With Knee Osteoarthritis in the Greek Population
pmc-11344598.creator: Christos Milaras, Panagiotis Lepetsos, Andreas Pampanos, Eustathios Kenanidis, George A Macheras, Despoina Mavrogianni, Dimitra Dafou, Michael Potoupnis, Eleftherios Tsiridis
pmc-11344598.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionPrimary knee osteoarthritis (OA) is a multifactorial degenerative joint disorder characterized by articular cartilage degradation. Matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) have been reported to play a vital role in OA pathogenesis, significantly contributing to extracellular matrix (ECM) catabolism.

pmc-12506980.title: Deep learning–empowered triboelectric acoustic textile for voice perception and intuitive generative AI-voice access on clothing
pmc-12506980.creator: Beibei Shao, Tai-Chen Wu, Zhi-Xian Yan, Tien-Yu Ko, Wei-Chen Peng, Dun-Jie Jhan, Yu-Hsiang Chang, Jiun-Wei Fong, Ming-Han Lu, Wei-Chun Yang, Jiann-Yeu Chen, Ming-Yen Lu, Baoquan Sun, Heng-Jui Liu, Ruiyuan Liu, Ying-Chih Lai
pmc-12506980.description: Integrating generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots with acoustic perception textiles allows everyday clothing to retrieve information, seek advice, and perform tasks through voice interactions. Here, we present a deep learning (DL)–empowered triboelectric AI acoustic textile (A-Textile) leveraging electrostatic charges on clothing for imperceptible, active voice perception and AI access.

pmc-12599728.title: Causal association between sepsis and acute respiratory distress syndrome: Evidence from a 2-sample Mendelian randomization study
pmc-12599728.creator: Pei Zhang, Wenbin Tian, Ye Tian, Ning Yu, Chao Liu, Shuxian Ma, Xueqing Li, Xiaoyu Zhou, Huaihai Lu
pmc-12599728.description: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is a life-threatening respiratory failure syndrome, and sepsis is a dysregulated host response to infection. Although sepsis is a major ARDS trigger, the causal relationship at the genetic level remains unestablished. This study assesses the causal effect of sepsis on the risk of ARDS using 2-sample Mendelian randomization (MR).

pmc-12816241.title: Arrhythmias across the tree of life: comparative insights for human electrophysiology
pmc-12816241.creator: Barbara Natterson-Horowitz, Kathy Wright, Glenn Van Steenkiste, Annelies Decloedt, Allison Lynne Gagnon, Xinjiang Cai, Alin Mazmanian
pmc-12816241.description: IntroductionArrhythmias in non-human animals offer insights into human electrophysiology, yet physicians may be unaware of their occurrence and significance. This paper presents selected examples of arrhythmias in dogs, horses, and birds— as an invitation to human cardiologists to explore how animal models can illuminate mechanisms, genetics, and therapeutic approaches relevant to human electrophysiology.

pmc-13117745.title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics and Co-Occurrence Patterns of Marine Fungal Communities Along Nutrient Gradients in the Leizhou Peninsula, China
pmc-13117745.creator: Yingyi Fan, Menghan Gao, Bihong Liu, Junyu Wei, Jianming Li, Zhangxi Hu
pmc-13117745.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Marine fungi are pivotal components of coastal ecosystems, facilitating essential biogeochemical cycling and trophic dynamics. However, the complex mechanisms governing their spatiotemporal community patterns in tropical–subtropical coasts remain largely unexplored. In this study, we characterized marine fungal diversity across a comprehensive seasonal cycle (spring (March), summer (June), autumn (August), and winter (December)) at 21 representative sites along the Leizhou Peninsula, China. These sites were strategically selected to encompass a broad range of dissolved inorganic nitrogen (DIN) gradients.

pmc-13152980.title: Incisional hernia and the risk of incident depression: a population-based propensity score–matched cohort study
pmc-13152980.creator: Andreas Krieg, Sarah Krieg, Karel Kostev
pmc-13152980.description: PurposeIncisional hernia is a common long-term complication of abdominal surgery and is traditionally seen as a structural defect. However, recent patient-centered research suggests that abdominal wall pathology may also impose substantial psychological burden. Whether incisional hernia is associated with an increased risk of clinically diagnosed depression at the population level remains unclear.

pmc-13355532.title: Neuroimaging evidence of mitochondrial dysfunction and inflammation in psychiatric disorders: a review
pmc-13355532.creator: Jing Li, Xian Ma, Juan Liu, Wanze Xu, Xiaoyi Zhang, Feifei Liang, Yu Dou

pmc-13383940.title: Deferred cord clamping in twin pregnancies: benefit, risk, or missed opportunity? A narrative review
pmc-13383940.creator: Aimann Surak, Graeme Polglase, Georg M Schmölzer
pmc-13383940.description: Deferred umbilical cord clamping enhances placental transfusion and is associated with improved outcomes in preterm infants. Following lung aeration and prior to umbilical cord clamping, the increase in pulmonary blood flow contributes to establishing blood volume within the pulmonary vascular bed, which constitutes the mechanism of physiology-based cord clamping.
